summary: Iteration 173 - Loyalty Member Rates, Marketing ROI Tracker, PWA Manifest tested. All 14 backend tests passed. Frontend loyalty flow verified with platinum member discount (18%) correctly applied. PWA manifest accessible and link tag present in index.html.

integration_issues.issue: Standard Playwright page.fill() does not trigger React's controlled input onChange properly. Requires using native input value setter with dispatchEvent to trigger React state updates.
integration_issues.workaround: Use page.evaluate with nativeInputValueSetter to set value and dispatch 'input' event
